Astronomer.description: A person who observes or supports observing. A first name alone is not an identity.

Telescope.description: An instrument that can be booked.

Duty.description:
Who runs or oversees a telescope.
An operator is not automatically its supervisor.

Mentorship.description: A senior astronomer guiding or assessing a junior one.

Session.description: Telescope time given to someone. state says requested, confirmed or cancelled; clear_sky stays empty until a sky report arrives.

messages.text:
Zainab Lowenthal: I booked Marlow Reflector for 3 nights from Monday, with Casimir Lowenthal as observer and Pallavi Dunmore as my backup.
Pallavi Dunmore: I can cover it, but I want the sky report first.

facts.in: I booked Marlow Reflector for 3 nights from Monday, with Casimir Lowenthal as observer and Pallavi Dunmore as my backup.

messages.text:
Subject: Hollowtree Dish rota

Hi all,

Zainab Quartey and Zainab Lowenthal both asked for the dish in March. Zainab Quartey gets priority because she filed first. Lowenthal can take the second week instead, and Zainab will confirm by Friday.

Thanks,
Mirko Sandoval

Minutes, scheduling call.
Mirko Sandoval opened: "The Varga Refractor is down until April." Eun-seo Bellamy disagreed: "Anselm Quartey told me it is back next week." Someone muttered "then who signs the repair?" and the chair moved on.
quotes: The Varga Refractor is down until April.
Anselm Quartey told me it is back next week.

messages.text:
Anselm Quartey: Zainab told me she wants Marlow Reflector for the 12 nights of the comet window.
Eun-seo Bellamy: Which Zainab? Lowenthal said "I am only asking for 4 nights" yesterday.
Anselm Quartey: Quartey, my cousin. She says she was promised the lot.
quotes: I am only asking for 4 nights

messages.text: Pallavi Dunmore supervises Hollowtree Dish. Eun-seo Bellamy operates it, and she wants the night shifts moved to her.
Forwarded from Casimir Lowenthal: "Zainab Rhee says she cannot make the Friday handover, and Pallavi Dunmore says the same about herself." He asked me to pass that on.
quotes: Zainab Rhee says she cannot make the Friday handover, and Pallavi Dunmore says the same about herself.

messages.text:
Mirko Sandoval: I supervise Hollowtree Dish now, not Pallavi.
Eun-seo Bellamy: Then my shifts report to you, and Pallavi stays as my advisor.
Pallavi Dunmore: I never advised you, Eun-seo.

Dear Anselm,

Zainab Rhee will run the Varga Refractor test night on Tuesday. Zainab Lowenthal examines her afterwards, and Zainab Quartey sits in as second marker, so please tell Zainab that the marks come to you.

Regards,
Pallavi Dunmore

facts.in: Zainab Rhee will run the Varga Refractor
facts.label: operates

messages.text: Attendance: Casimir Lowenthal, Zainab Lowenthal and Anselm Quartey; apologies from Zainab Quartey and Zainab Rhee. Casimir proposed a new rota, Quartey seconded it, and Rhee asked whether Zainab could chair next time. Lowenthal said "let us decide in April" and nobody objected.

Eun-seo Bellamy wrote: "Marlow Reflector is mine on the 9th." Mirko Sandoval replied, "no, I confirmed it for Zainab Quartey," and then added "sorry". My own note said "ask Eun-seo about the key" and nothing more. The log keeper noted "both of you should check the calendar" without saying who had asked.
quotes: Marlow Reflector is mine on the 9th.
no, I confirmed it for Zainab Quartey,
both of you should check the calendar

messages.text:
Casimir Lowenthal: I advise Zainab Rhee, and I have the dish from the 2nd.
Zainab Rhee: He does not advise me, I only share his office. Pallavi Dunmore advises me.
Pallavi Dunmore: She is my advisee, yes. Casimir, stop claiming her.

Note to self: someone from the university rang about the Varga Refractor. They said their engineer would visit on the 5th, and I told them Eun-seo Bellamy holds the key. She may want to speak to them first.
Mirko Sandoval to all: I cancelled Hollowtree Dish for 2 nights because Zainab Quartey and Zainab Lowenthal both withdrew. If Casimir Lowenthal asks, tell him that Zainab may rebook in May.

facts.in: I cancelled Hollowtree Dish for 2 nights

messages.text: Ledger of requests: Anselm Quartey asked for Marlow Reflector (2 nights); Eun-seo Bellamy asked for Varga Refractor (5 nights); Zainab Rhee asked for Hollowtree Dish (1 night). Anselm and Eun-seo are both first-time applicants, while Rhee has booked before.

facts.in: Anselm Quartey asked for Marlow Reflector (2 nights)
Eun-seo Bellamy asked for Varga Refractor (5 nights)
Zainab Rhee asked for Hollowtree Dish (1 night)

messages.text: Casimir Lowenthal told Mirko Sandoval that he should not book Marlow Reflector twice, but he replied that his own request was still pending. Their supervisor, Pallavi Dunmore, will decide.
Draft rota (not final): Hollowtree Dish pencilled in for Zainab Rhee, 6 nights in May, if Pallavi Dunmore signs off. Zainab knows, and Rhee has already told Eun-seo Bellamy and Casimir Lowenthal.

facts.in: Hollowtree Dish pencilled in for Zainab Rhee, 6 nights in May

messages.text: Eun-seo Bellamy: Can Zainab Quartey take over my Tuesday observing slot at Varga Refractor? Zainab Lowenthal could do it as well, but I would rather ask Quartey first.

facts.in: Can Zainab Quartey take over my Tuesday observing slot at Varga Refractor?

messages.text:
I pasted this from the group chat. Pallavi Dunmore: "Hollowtree Dish needs a new feed horn."
Mirko Sandoval: "Then ask Anselm Quartey." My own reply was "fine, I will" and then I added "Anselm knows me".
quotes: Hollowtree Dish needs a new feed horn.

messages.text: Casimir Lowenthal operates Marlow Reflector and Casimir Ostrowe supervises it. Casimir will sign the log, according to the notice, and he also keeps the keys.
Notice from the director: "All booking requests close on Friday," wrote Pallavi Dunmore, who also noted that "late ones go to Zainab Rhee first". Zainab Lowenthal read both lines aloud.
quotes: All booking requests close on Friday,
late ones go to Zainab Rhee first

questions.q: Who is the operator of Hollowtree Dish?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Telescope)-[:operator]->(n1:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Hollowtree Dish' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: mir
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)-[:supervises]->(n1:Telescope) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the advisor of Eun-seo Bellamy?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)-[:advisor]->(n1:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Eun-seo Bellamy' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: pal
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)-[:advises]->(n1:Astronomer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Is there a record of the sky being clear for Marlow Reflector?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Telescope)<-[:telescope]-(n1:Session) WHERE n0.name = 'Marlow Reflector' RETURN coalesce(n1.clear_sky, false) AS clear_sky

questions.q: How many nights did Zainab Rhee book?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)<-[:booked_by]-(n1:Session) WHERE n0.name = 'Zainab Rhee' RETURN n1.nights AS nights

questions.q: Which sessions am I backing up?
questions.speaker: pal
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)<-[:backup]-(n1:Session) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.nights AS nights

questions.q: Who observes in the Varga Refractor sessions?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Telescope)<-[:telescope]-(n1:Session)-[:observer]->(n2:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Varga Refractor' RETURN n2.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Pallavi Dunmore' RETURN n0.email AS email

questions.q: Who is the supervisor of Marlow Reflector?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Telescope)-[:supervisor]->(n1:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Marlow Reflector' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Astronomer)-[:advises]->(n1:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Casimir Lowenthal' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which telescopes does Eun-seo Bellamy operate?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)-[:operates]->(n1:Telescope) WHERE n0.name = 'Eun-seo Bellamy' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the examiner of Zainab Rhee?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Astronomer)-[:examiner]->(n1:Astronomer) WHERE n0.name = 'Zainab Rhee' RETURN n1.name AS name
